sections.intent: Unfold the brooding darkness of Bhairav, oscillating softly on Komal Re and Dhaivat
sections.transition: Tanpura swells as the distorted rhythm guitar strikes a crushing low Sa on sam

sections.intent: State the gat head firmly over the crushing doom rhythm
sections.transition: A descending fill leads smoothly into the mandra bridge

sections.intent: Delve into the low mandra octave with heavy, drawn-out strokes
sections.transition: Sitar slides up to Mandra Ni launching directly back into the mukhada sam

sections.intent: Re-establish the mukhada with doubled palm-mutes and crashing cymbals
sections.transition: Kick builds up into the higher register transition

sections.intent: Ascend into the taar octave, reaching up to Taar Sa and Komal Re
sections.transition: Drums switch to driving double kick under the ascending sitar run

sections.intent: Explosive chaugun taans soaring across the octaves over relentless doom groove
sections.transition: A sharp cadential descent slamming straight into the final mukhada on sam

sections.intent: Final crushing statement of the mukhada with all instruments in unison weight
sections.transition: Cymbals wash as the final chord sustains and rhythm decays

sections.intent: Harmonic feedback ringing out over low Sa power chord and tanpura drone

request: a dark doom fusion in Bhairav, key of E, teental, 120 bpm

seed_riff.reasoning: Anchored on low Sa (beat 1), driving through Komal Re palm-mutes, expanding to Ga and Ma, resting on the khali (beat 9) with sustained Pa, and resolving via Dha and Komal Re back to Sa.

phrase_plan.climax_and_sam: Peaks on komal Dha at matra 13, sweeps down through komal Re to land decisively on sam Sa

seed_head.idea: A dark, dragging Bhairav gat head that lands heavily on Sa, breathes on Pa, and sweeps down through komal Dha and Re

energy_arc: alaap: somber and dark awakening over the tanpura drone (low intensity); mukhada: heavy doom groove enters locking the riff with the sitar hook (moderate-high); manjha: pulls the energy inward down into the mandra register (moderate); return mukhada: re-asserts the main groove with increased weight (high); antara: ascends to the higher octave with rising urgency (high); taan_long: driven climax with rapid chaugun taan bursts over galloping doom drums (peak); mukhada: triumphant, crushing return of the theme on sam (peak resolution); outro: resonant, decaying chords around the resting Sa (fade to silence).

rhythm_section.reasoning: The key of E with Bhairav raga anchors heavily on Sa (E). Section 0 is sitar/drone only. Section 1 (mukhada) introduces the crushing doom half-time groove: holding S power chord for 8 beats punctuated by anchoring 8th-note chugs, moving to r for 4 beats, then d for 2 beats, and resolving back to S for 2 beats with a 16th-note turnaround into sam. Section 2 (manjha) shifts harmony into d (8 beats), P (4 beats), S (4 beats) with sparse, heavy ringing chords supporting the sitar's descent into the mandra register and answering in the sitar's rest at beats 12-16. Section 3 returns to the mukhada via same_as section 1. Section 4 (antara) climbs an octave higher with sparse power chords ringing across the 4-beat vibhags (m -> P -> d -> S(+1)) letting the sitar's high taar flourishes resonate clearly. Section 5 (taan_long) provides the climactic breakdown drive: continuous driving chugs on the S pedal anchored with grinding d moves to propel the rapid chaugun taan. Section 6 reprises the crushing mukhada via same_as section 1. Section 7 (outro) lets the low Sa power chord sustain for the full 16 beats with natural decay and feedback under the tihai-like descending phrase.

parts.role: Mukhada doom foundation: crushing sustained home Sa with 8th-note chugs, transitioning through r and d to sam turnaround.
Manjha: deep, sparse resonant chords allowing the sitar's mandra exploration to breathe, answering firmly in the beat 12-16 rest.
Mukhada return: replay established doom groove pattern identical to section 1.
Antara: ascending power chords in octave (+1) ringing across 4-beat vibhag boundaries, keeping space open for sitar's gamaks.
Taan breakdown: relentless driving chug pedal on low Sa with grinding d accents pushing the peak energy underneath the chaugun runs.
Final mukhada: triumphant return locking to sam unison weight.
Outro: massive ringing low Sa drone power chord slowly decaying with feedback across the entire avartan.
